Title: Admins can't access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal

User impact: Admins can't access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal.

More info: Admins report that clicking on the Action center causes the page to stall and never load.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender XDR services and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins can't access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal

User impact: Admins can't access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal.

More info: Admins report that clicking on the Action center causes the page to stall and never load.

Current status: We're reviewing raised support cases to further our understanding of the ongoing impact scenario and attempting to reproduce the issue internally to assist with our troubleshooting efforts.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and any admin can't access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal as the page stalls and never loads. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 6:30 PM UTC

Title: Some admins may be unable to access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal

User impact: Admins may be unable to access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal.

More info: Admins report that clicking on the Action center causes the page to stall and never load.

Current status: After further analysis of the internal reproduction of impact, we've isolated that impact is broader than initially diagnosed and we've expanded our communications to encompass all potentially affected admins. We've updated the "Title", "User impact", and "Scope of impact" fields of our communications to reflect this change.

We've isolated that a recent update to migrate to a new code base for the Microsoft Defender portal contained a failing component that’s resulting in stalling and failures when admins attempt to access the Action center. We're rolling back the problematic update to remediate impact, and we anticipate this process to be completed by our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: Some admins may be unable to access the Action center in the Microsoft Defender portal as the page stalls and never loads. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Root cause: A recent update to migrate to a new code base for the Microsoft Defender portal contained a failing component that’s resulting in stalling and failures when admins attempt to access the Action center.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
